name: El Retiro (Colombia)
description: White field charged with a green triangle from the hoist reaching the fly, bordered by a row of small white stars.
history: Municipal flag of Retiro, a municipality in the department of Antioquia, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: large triangle from the hoist to the fly, edged with small white stars
row of small stars along the edges of the triangle
